comment: Read from src/Hutara.cpp at commit 90c6a4e, the only state this repository has ever carried version 2.0.0 in. The repository also holds a stale copy of the same file at its root, with a WAVEFOLD parameter and a different jack layout; that copy does not match the installed module and was ignored. The saw output is unipolar because src/Hutara.cpp:243 computes two times the phase rather than two times the phase minus one, which the maker's README does not mention. The FM Amount knob multiplies its own jack twice, at src/Hutara.cpp:178 and again at 181, so the jack arrives scaled by the square of the knob; that reads as an oversight rather than a design. The variable psychedelicCVAll at src/Hutara.cpp:169 has the Psychedelic CV knob added to it at line 172 and is then never read, so that addition has no effect; only the inverted copy taken at line 171 reaches anything. The square wave is decided from the phase of the previous sample, at src/Hutara.cpp:254, one sample before the phase is advanced. The maker's README describes the Final Output as the combined output of all waveforms and does not say that it is multiplied by the Resample jack, so it does not mention that the output is silent with that jack unpatched.
